integrity: The proof uses published bounded-operator identities with new resolvent and uniform finite-part calculations; the finite exact checker is supplemental only.
scientific_limitations: The asymptotic is for the canonical Ma order-two interrupter, not the actual Cesàro self-commutator, and no higher-order or nonreal-shift assertion is proved. Originality is limited by unindexed literature and no independent external check.
title: An exponentially weak negative spectral mode at the second-order Cesàro boundary
